scope: Read-only minimal hand-readiness candidate; no source/runtime mutation and no active run read.

Pre-countdown countdown==0 can insert it; countdown>0 removes it; first active countdown==0 inserts a fresh host. This source path explains two possible scene lifetimes, not the observed GPU delay.

Portrait RootView.swift:2269-2285 similarly removes whole cue block; GripDiagramView pair and single wrappers create their own models. Fixing landscape pair alone must not be claimed to fix portrait/single readiness.
